subject: POC alignment: proposed success metrics, owners, and timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Ruiz <alexa.ruiz@intelliprod.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC alignment: proposed success metrics, owners, and timeline

Hi Alexa — thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight plan to get the POC moving: 

Summary of needs (from call):
- Validate Redwood inference on your order-extraction pipeline for 2M monthly transactions
- Keep latency under 300ms p50 for 512-token inference paths
- Verify end-to-end data handling (S3 -> Redwood, no raw persistence)

Proposed success criteria (attached template):
1) Functional: 90%+ extraction F1 on the 5K sample set you shared
2) Latency: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 750ms under expected traffic (batching off for initial tests)
3) Ops: automated retry and KV-cache hit rate >= 60%

Suggested timeline (4-week sprint):
- Week 0 (kickoff): confirm stakeholders, grant dev S3 read access or API token, share baseline sample
- Week 1: data onboarding + small-scale runs (1000 recs)
- Week 2: model tuning + metric collection; first readout
- Week 3: scale to 10k+ records, acceptance readout and wrap-up

Ownership (please confirm):
- Redwood trial owner: Ben Carter (I'll coordinate infra + model config)
- CS / success lead: Marissa Cole (will run ops/runbook and readouts)
- IntelliProd technical lead: (please confirm a name/email)

Attachments: poc-success-metrics-template.xlsx (simple tracker you can edit)

Next steps: can you confirm the IntelliProd POC lead and whether S3 credentials or an API integration is easier on your side? Also let me know if the timeline above looks feasible — we can shift by a week if needed. I'll queue Marissa to prepare the runbook once we have the lead.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Alexa Ruiz <alexa.ruiz@intelliprod.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC alignment: proposed success metrics, owners, and timeline

Ben — thanks for the clear summary and the template. Quick answers / asks from our side: 

1) Data access: S3 read access is preferred for the initial run; we can generate a short-lived role.
2) Stakeholders: I'll be the exec sponsor; my day-to-day lead will be Jeremy Park (jeremy.park@intelliprod.com) — he's copied on this reply to loop him in.
3) Latency: our internal ops team would be comfortable with p50 < 350ms for the initial evaluation window; we can tighten to 300ms for final acceptance. Is there a way we can measure tokenized latency end-to-end?
4) Security/SLA: can you share a short checklist for required evidence (SOC2, retention controls, audit logs)? We need that for procurement.

One scheduling note: several stakeholders are out the week of Dec 14; can we shift the kickoff to the week of Dec 21? If that's a hard blocker, we can do an async kickoff and start onboarding earlier — I'd prefer to get the trial lined up so we don't lose momentum.

I've attached our internal acceptance criteria draft (POC-approval.pdf) so you can see the format we use.

Thanks — Alexa
Alexa Ruiz
Head of Product Ops
IntelliProd, Inc.
alexa.ruiz@intelliprod.com | +1 (650) 555-2234

Hi Alexa / team — looping in details to address the security and ops asks and to propose a slightly adjusted plan that accommodates your stakeholder availability. 

Security / evidence: we can provide the following artifacts for procurement review: SOC 2 Type II summary, data handling whitepaper, audit-log export examples, and an encryption/KMS diagram. I'm attaching a short checklist we typically send (security-evidence-checklist.xlsx). If you have specific fields I should include in the procurement packet, let me know.

Latency measurement: we instrument end-to-end request/response timestamps in the trial telemetry; Redwood Console will show p50/p95 token-level and end-to-end. Sean will set up a dashboard link for you.

Dedicated capacity: we can provision a limited dedicated pool for the POC for a 4-week window. There's a nominal trial fee tied to reserved capacity; we can include a promotional credit in the proposal — I'll confirm the exact numbers with finance if you want to pursue dedicated.

Revised kickoff proposal: because several stakeholders are out the week of Dec 14, can we plan a kickoff for Tue Dec 22, 2026? Plan: asynchronous onboarding this week (S3 credentials + sample upload) and formal kick on Dec 22. That keeps momentum without forcing attendees to be present.

Action items / owners (please confirm):
- IntelliProd: generate an IAM role + S3 prefix for Redwood (Jeremy)
- Redwood: trial ops runbook + initial dashboard (Marissa)
- Redwood: telemetry/dashboard link and baseline tests (Sean)
- IntelliProd: sign-off on success metrics in attached tracker (Alexa)

Attachments: trial-ops-runbook.pdf (draft runbook), security-evidence-checklist.xlsx

If the timeline works, I'll publish the runbook to the shared Drive and we'll open the kickoff slot on Dec 22.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
